correctness.rationale: For every u, Cauchy's eight facet-normal sum reduces exactly to B=max(2a,a+b+c). Haar measure disintegrates as da dphi in the signed-and-sorted fundamental chamber. At fixed a, phi is uniform on the explicitly bounded arc, hence Psi uniform [0,q]. A monotone cosine pushforward proves the stated three support regimes, atom, density and conditional mean. Endpoint point masses are limits; no positive-probability conditioning is assumed at exact a. The standalone stdlib verifier independently checks 360000 directional evaluations and moments, not an infinite-domain proof.
